newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Farmers Bank hikes MLR, cuts deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Thai Farmers Bank hikes MLR, cuts deposit rates.

text.p: Thai Farmers Bank Plc said on Wednesday that it had raised its key minimum lending rate by 100 basis points to 13.75 percent and reversed a Tuesday deposit rate hike back down to 10.00-11.50 percent.
The minimum lending rate is that offered to most credit worthy corporate clients.
It also raised the minimum overdraft rate to 14.25 percent and minimum retail rates to 14.00 percent from 13.25 percent and 13.00 percent respectively.
The official declined to elaborate why Thai Farmers Bank decided to bring fixed deposit rate back to 10.00-11.50 percent from 10.50-11.75 percent announced on Tuesday.
However, the move followed that of Thailand's top bank, Bangkok Bank Plc, which also raised its deposit rates briefly and reversed them on Tuesday.
